issues_detected.description: Creator affiliations and funding disagree inside the record. All PIs Aaron Y. Lee and Cecilia S. Lee carry affiliations ROR:01yc7t268 'Washington University in St. Louis', while the same record's grant description says OT2OD032644 was 'awarded to the University of Washington with Aaron Lee as principal investigator', the creator description says 'the RO-Crate records the affiliation as the Department of Ophthalmology, University of Washington', and the corresponding address is leeay@uw.edu. The record applies its tier ranking and declares the conflict in source_caveats (5), but the structured value most likely encodes a source error.
issues_detected.recommendation: Treat the 'Washington University in St. Louis' / 'Washington University IRB' values as a probable metadata error in the FAIRhub/RO-Crate source and confirm against the UW IRB protocol STUDY00016228 and the RePORTER award before recording ROR:01yc7t268 as the structured affiliation.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified.method states 'No active de-identification was necessary because no identifiers were collected', yet the same record documents consent with electronic signatures, EHR extraction, Department of Licensing driving records, and a controlled tier holding '5-digit ZIP code, sex, race, ethnicity, genetic sequencing data, past health records', and identifiers_removed lists 'Protected health information'. The two de-identification accounts (NoDeIdentification vs HIPAA Safe Harbor stripping) are recorded side by side (source_caveats item 6) rather than resolved.
issues_detected.recommendation: State that identifiers were collected for study operations and withheld from the release, and name Safe Harbor as the method applied to the public tier; drop the 'no identifiers were collected' phrasing.

issues_detected.description: regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level 'restricted' is a mapping from the source's 'HL7:2N (normal)', and confidential_elements.confidential_elements_present: false sits beside sensitive_elements.sensitive_elements_present: true. The record explains each choice, but the public/controlled two-tier release means a single confidentiality level under-describes the dataset.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record the confidentiality level per tier (public download vs DUA-controlled) or note in the level's description that the controlled tier is stricter.

issues_detected.description: external_resources entry 'AI-READI biospecimen repository' places a plain-text institution name ('University of Alabama at Birmingham Center for Clinical and Translational Science') in a URL-typed list.
issues_detected.recommendation: Move the institution name to the description and leave external_resources empty or supply the biorepository's web page.

issues_detected.description: Sustainability: version_access reports the v2.0.0 FAIRhub page says 'This version of the dataset is no longer accessible', and FAIRhub is described as 'the AI-READI-specific data management platform' hosted on Azure by the project. Older DOIs therefore resolve to landing pages without data, and no institutional preservation commitment beyond the award period (ending 2025-08-31) is documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the post-award hosting commitment and whether superseded versions are archived even if not downloadable.

issues_detected.description: Bias entries use typed categories (selection_bias, representation_bias, sampling_bias, measurement_bias) and mitigations but carry no AIO/ontology mapping, and the 'measurement_bias' entry omits affected_subsets. future_use_impacts covers re-identification only, not downstream fairness of models trained on a deliberately non-representative cohort.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add AIO term references for each bias type and a fairness statement about model generalisation given the balanced (non-representative) design and the excluded groups.

issues_detected.description: Missing mandatory-tier fields: resources and parent_datasets are absent although file_collections enumerates nine directories with counts and bytes, and related_datasets links prior versions with is_new_version_of. The information exists but is not expressed in the fields Q1/Q19 look for.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate resources from file_collections and parent_datasets/was_derived_from from the is_new_version_of relations.

semantic_insights: DOI 10.60775/fairhub.3 is well-formed; the 10.60775 prefix is FAIRhub's DataCite prefix and is used consistently across id, doi, version_access and file_collections ids.
Grant numbers OT2OD032644, P30DK035816 and UL1TR003096 all follow NIH activity-code patterns and are corroborated with RePORTER application and project numbers.
All 16 named creators carry ORCIDs and ROR-identified affiliations; ROR ids are syntactically valid.
Temporal ordering is consistent: IRB approval 2022-12-20 -> collection 2023-07-19 to 2025-05-01 -> release 2025-11-17; three release dates match version_access and related_datasets.

Instance count 2,280 agrees with subpopulations distribution sums (380+545+519+836 = 2,280; 951+1,329 = 2,280; 1,576+352+352 = 2,280) and with file totals 356,343 / 3.82 TB; file_collections byte sums (~3.816e12) match total_size_bytes.

Licensing is semantically coherent: the AI-READI Data License v2.0 (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17555036) is distinguished from CC-BY 4.0 for documentation, and prohibited_uses are drawn from the license text rather than invented.
Human-subjects logic holds: involves_human_subjects true with ethical_reviews, informed_consent, participant_compensation and at_risk_populations all populated.

Source disagreements (acronym expansion, enrollment target, size, start date, institution, de-identification) are enumerated in source_caveats with the tier rule applied, so every structured choice is auditable.

strengths: Near-complete structural coverage with quantified, mutually consistent counts (participants, splits, demographics, files, bytes) across description, instances, subpopulations, splits and file_collections.
Persistent identifiers throughout: dataset DOI, per-version DOIs, ORCIDs for all 16 PIs, ROR ids for affiliations, sites and funder, MeSH data_topic, ClinicalTrials.gov registration.
Collection protocol documented to device model and procedure level, with eligibility, exclusion, recruitment, consent and result-return pathways.
Governance and licensing fully specified for both tiers, with prohibited uses transcribed from the actual license and documentation licence distinguished from data licence.
Source disagreements are enumerated with the tier rule applied, making every contested structured value auditable.
weaknesses: Structured affiliation and IRB institution follow a tier-1 source that conflicts with the grant award, corresponding address and protocol publication (Washington University in St. Louis vs University of Washington).
is_deidentified asserts no identifiers were collected, contradicted by the record's own account of consent, EHR extraction and the controlled tier.
resources, parent_datasets, was_derived_from and errata are absent although the underlying information is present elsewhere.
Conversion and curation software is unnamed and unversioned; only the GitHub organization is linked.
Social-impact and fairness analysis is limited to re-identification risk; no AIO mappings on biases and no discouraged_uses.
recommendations: Verify the responsible institution against STUDY00016228 and the RePORTER award and correct the structured affiliation/IRB values, keeping the source discrepancy in source_caveats.
Reword is_deidentified.method to state that operational identifiers were collected and withheld, naming Safe Harbor for the public tier.
Populate resources from file_collections and parent_datasets/was_derived_from from the is_new_version_of relations; add an errata entry pointing to CHANGELOG.md.
Name and version the conversion tools (fda/sdt to DICOM, FIT to Open mHealth) and link the specific AI-READI repositories.
Add AIO term references to known_biases, a fairness statement on generalisation from the balanced design, and discouraged_uses; document the post-award hosting commitment for FAIRhub.
